---

**From:** Camille Fontaine | Digital Asset Desk
**Instrument:** FLOP-HTLC
**Side:** Buy
**Quantity:** 26,474 units
**Structure:** Firm, subject to standard HTLC settlement conditions

---

Counterparties,

I am seeking to acquire **26,474 units of FLOP-HTLC** on a firm basis. This is a clean, straightforward accumulation — no exotic structuring, no contingent legs. I am prepared to move quickly on the right terms.

- **Pricing:** Open to negotiation. Send your best offer — I will respond to serious quotes only.
- **Execution:** I value discretion and precision. Counterparties with verified on-chain history and clean settlement records will receive priority.
- **Timeline:** I am looking to conclude within a reasonable window. Indecision costs

---

**TERMS & CONDITIONS**

- **Execution:** On-chain atomic swap or OTC settlement, at counterparty's preference.

**RATIONALE**

A position of 25,209 ETH represents a meaningful allocation. I am seeking a clean, transparent swap with a reputable counterparty — no intermediaries, no ambiguity. Terms are negotiable within reason, but speed and certainty of settlement are non-negotiable.
